text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Run, run.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Faster than anyone else! Like my true
self!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Not for anybody else—just for me!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess is first! She's claimed
victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: RRRAAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Incredible.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Scarlet, you look so stupid! Don't
tell me...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You thought you were the one fit to be
queen?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hit the nail on the head, huh? Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You're the same as me, then.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sweep...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't able to win today. Kawakami is
the
queen.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: But I definitely won't lose next time.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Right. I won't lose either.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Not to her... or any other veteran racers.
I'll
surpass you all one day.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I really wanted Daiwa Scarlet to win...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
But wasn't Kawakami's running just
amazing?
Like, it looked really powerful,
or something...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess! Would you tell us
how you're
feeling after today's race?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
You defeated Daiwa Scarlet, who had
entered
the race in place of Vodka,
but—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Both she and I were running for
ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Please don't get it twisted.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: ...Oh! I'm terribly sorry!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. I'd also like to express my
gratitude to all
the fans out there who
came to watch our race
today.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for everything up to this
point.

text_block_list.name: Suntanned Boy
text_block_list.text:
P-Princess?! "Up to this point"? Don't
tell me
you're going to stop racing...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: What?! Stop racing? Me?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Of course not! My battle is far from
done.
choice_data_list: するつもりはないよな
するつもりはないよね
choice_data_list_en: You're not planning on doing it, right?
You're not planning on doing it, are you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"You aren't fit to enter a dignified and
historic
race like the Queen Elizabeth II
Cup. You never
were."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
However, I want to become the princess
that I
envision for myself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I haven't finished showing everyone the
type of
princess I am.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It would make me happy if the path I
tread one
day serves as a model for
someone else's future.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But regardless of whether that happens,
I run for
my own sake.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
There will be people who don't accept
me as a
princess, but that's only because
their idea of one
differs from my own.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
However, this is the princess that I am. I
won't
stray from my path.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What's mine is mine. And I am proud to
be the
way I am—exactly the kind of
princess I want to
be.
